card_suite_summaries.name: 20-Pack Thank You Card Set - Caleania Landscape
card_suite_summaries.description: Showcase your elegant style with the Caleania suite. Printed on luxe paper, this design features intricate floral details and a timeless mix of typography. We think it strikes the perfect balance of formal and fun. This suite was created in collaboration with Jen Owens (@jen.owens2), a self-taught stationery and surface pattern designer. Her intricate style is a blend of whimsy and vintage-vibe. Her work can be found on stationery, fabric, and wallpaper.

lead_card.name: Paper 20-Pack Thank You Card Set - Caleania Landscape

card_suite_summaries.name: 20-Pack Thank You Card Set - Essenza Bloom
card_suite_summaries.description: Make them smile with the Essenza Bloom thank you card. Printed on luxe paper, this elegant design features minimalist, continuous-line floral drawings and a timeless mix of typography. We especially love it for weddings in venues filled with fresh touches.

lead_card.name: Paper 20-Pack Thank You Card Set - Essenza Bloom

card_suite_summaries.name: 20-Pack Thank You Card Set - Deepcreek
card_suite_summaries.description: Celebrate your love with our Deepcreek thank you card. Printed on luxe paper, this watercolor design features gorgeous renderings of landscapes in every season. We think this is a genius choice for couples getting married in the great outdoors (or just really love being one with nature).

lead_card.name: Paper 20-Pack Thank You Card Set - Deepcreek

card_suite_summaries.name: 20-Pack Thank You Card Set - Roberts Landscape
card_suite_summaries.description: Make a minimalist statement with the Roberts Landscape thank you card. Printed on luxe paper, this modern design features a chic mix of typography and calligraphy on a sleek, solid background. We especially love it for couples who prefer a less-is-more aesthetic.

lead_card.name: Paper 20-Pack Thank You Card Set - Roberts Landscape

card_suite_summaries.name: 20-Pack Thank You Card Set - Galata
card_suite_summaries.description: Reflect your wedding style with our Galata thank you card. Printed on luxe paper, this botanical design features leafy eucalyptus garlands that frame your words of thanks perfectly. Suited for outdoor weddings and indoor weddings alike.
